job.title: Engagement Coordinator
job.description:
Position Overview
The Warehouse Engagement Coordinator plays a vital role in maintaining a positive, efficient, and well-coordinated work environment for all hourly associates. This individual serves as a key point of contact for team members—helping answer questions, supporting the flow of associates during breaks and lunches, and ensuring that daily operations run smoothly in all areas of the warehouse.
The ideal candidate is approachable, energetic, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where teamwork, communication, and people skills are essential.

Work location: Phillipsburg, NJ
Pay Rate: $21.25-26.25 through 12/5
Pay Rate: $21.25-23.25 12/5 and after
Shift: Various- Day, Night, Weekends
Languages: English/Haitan Creole & Spanish


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the on-floor contact for hourly associates—answering questions, addressing concerns, and maintaining a positive, professional environment.
  • Help coordinate employee flow during breaks, lunches, and shift changes to ensure efficiency and minimize time off task.
  • Act as a Culture Keeper by modeling Integrity’s core values and promoting teamwork, engagement, and adherence to attendance, safety, and productivity expectations.
  • Monitor associate engagement, production output, and on-task performance; provide real-time coaching and encouragement to help maintain alignment with goals.
  • Identify, track, and report associate barriers that impact performance or morale, ensuring timely communication and escalation with internal leaders and the client for resolution.
  • Support onboarding, orientation, and communication to new and existing associates, fostering a connected and informed workforce.
  • Walk process paths and production areas regularly to stay visible, address needs promptly, and ensure a clean, safe, and welcoming environment.
  • Partner with operations and HR teams to implement process improvements, engagement activities, and initiatives that increase productivity and morale.


Qualifications

  • HS Diploma or GED
  • Bilingual in Spanish is preferred
  • Previous experience in a warehouse, logistics, or high-volume operations environment preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to connect with a diverse workforce.
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to multitask in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.
  • Ability to remain calm, approachable, and professional under pressure.
  • Must be comfortable spending most of the day walking or standing throughout the facility.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and adapt to changing priorities.


Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to stand and walk for the duration of the shift (8–10 hours).
  • Frequent movement through warehouse process paths and break areas.
  • Ability to bend, reach, and lift up to 45 lbs as needed.


Our Use of AI - We utilize artificial intelligence and automated decision-making tools provided by third-party vendors as part of our candidate recruitment, screening, evaluation, and matching services. The AI Tools may perform functions including: screening resumes, conducting preliminary interviews, assessing qualifications, matching candidates to jobs, and generating candidate insights or recommendations. The AI Tools provide recommendations only and do not make final employment decisions. job.title: Farm Operations
job.description:
Assembly Associate (Farm Operations) – 1-Week Project (Day Shift)

Pay: $18.00/hour
Schedule: Monday, November 20 – Monday, November 27 | 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Location: Phillipsburg, NJ 08865 (190 Strykers Rd)
Type: Full-time hours for project duration (short-term project)

About the role
We’re hiring Assembly Associates to support a short-term project at Oishii, an indoor vertical farm specializing in growing strawberries. In this role, you’ll be on your feet most of the day, using your hands to repot plants and place them into a rack system. You’ll work in a clean, climate-controlled environment with strict hygiene and PPE requirements.

What you’ll do
- Repot plants using your hands (and occasional small hand tools) while handling plants carefully
- Stand for most of the shift (breaks provided)
- Follow cleanroom-style processes and detailed instructions
- Wear required PPE throughout most of the shift (clean suit, gloves, hair covering/hood, mask, and provided farm shoes)
- May work around water (you may get slightly wet)
- May be asked to work on or operate a platform lift (up to ~20 ft) to place plants into the rack system

Requirements / work rules (must be followed)
- Must arrive clean and in clean clothing (including clean socks)
- No accessories or jewelry; no hats
- Must be odor-free (including marijuana) — drug-free workplace with zero tolerance
- Must be willing to remove shoes to enter the changing area and change into required scrubs/farm PPE
- Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs
- Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and attention to detail
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and following outlined processes

PPE / dress code
- Steel-toed boots are required
- Additional PPE is provided by the client (farm suit, gloves, hairnet/hood, mask, farm shoes, etc.)

Benefits & perks (Integrity Staffing)
- Weekly paychecks
- Benefits from day one (medical, dental, vision, telemedicine)
- Multiple medical plan options
- Group term life insurance (employee, spouse, children)
- Short-term disability
- Prescription discount program (for enrolled medical members)
- Employee Assistance Program
- Career growth opportunities and skill development
- Potential access to a 401(k) program

How the hiring process works
- No resume/interview required
- The branch will submit names to the client prior to start

Apply now
If you’re immediately available and can meet the hygiene/PPE requirements, apply now for consideration!

Integrity Staffing Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Warehouse Associate I
job.description:
Warehouse Associate / Material Handler

Integrity Staffing Solutions

Location: Alpharetta, GA
Pay Rate: $19.00/hr
Schedule: 11am - 7:30pm Mon - Fri
Job Type: Temp to Hire

Join Our Team!

Looking for a hands-on opportunity where you can stay active, build valuable skills, and be part of a team that keeps operations moving?

Integrity Staffing Solutions is hiring dependable, detail-oriented Warehouse Associates / Material Handlers to support warehouse and distribution operations.

Whether you have previous warehouse experience or are looking to get started in the industry, this could be a great opportunity for you!

In this role, you'll help ensure materials and products are received, organized, tracked, and shipped accurately and efficiently. We're looking for individuals who take pride in their work, value safety, and enjoy working in a team-oriented environment.

What You'll Do

As a Warehouse Associate / Material Handler, your responsibilities will include:

  • Receiving & Inventory: Receive, inspect, label, and organize incoming materials and products.
  • Order Fulfillment: Pick, pack, stage, and prepare customer orders for accurate and timely shipment.
  • Loading & Unloading: Safely load, unload, and move materials using appropriate equipment and procedures.
  • Inventory Management: Maintain accurate inventory records and assist with cycle counts, physical inventory, and stock replenishment.
  • Warehouse Organization: Stock, store, and organize materials to maintain an efficient and orderly work environment.
  • Shipping & Documentation: Process shipments, transfers, returns, and related paperwork or system entries.
  • Quality Control: Inspect products and materials for damage, shortages, or discrepancies and promptly report concerns.
  • Equipment Operation: Operate warehouse tools and equipment following established safety guidelines and training.
  • Safety & Teamwork: Maintain a clean, safe workspace and collaborate with warehouse, operations, purchasing, and other departments.
  • Additional Support: Assist with special projects and other warehouse duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for reliable individuals who are eager to learn and contribute to a successful team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Previous warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, or material-handling experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Willingness and ability to learn warehouse equipment, systems, and processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and meet productivity expectations.
  • Ability to work effectively with others in a team environment.
  • Commitment to following workplace safety procedures and established operating guidelines.
  • Forklift or other equipment certification may be required for certain assignments.

No previous warehouse experience? We encourage you to apply! A strong work ethic, dependability, and willingness to learn are important qualities for success in this role.

Why Work with Integrity Staffing Solutions?

At Integrity Staffing Solutions, we believe that when our associates succeed, everyone succeeds.

We put people first by providing support and resources to help our associates feel prepared, confident, and successful on the job.

Depending on eligibility and assignment details, associate benefits and resources may include:

  • Access to medical benefits.
  • Flexible pay options, including daily pay where available.
  • Training and certification resources.
  • Support from a dedicated staffing team.
  • Opportunities to develop valuable warehouse and logistics skills.

Ready to Get Started?

If you're dependable, safety-conscious, and ready to be part of a hardworking team, we want to hear from you!

Apply today with Integrity Staffing Solutions and take the next step in your career!

Integrity Staffing Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws.

job.title: Shipping and FulFillment Associate
job.description:
Shipping and Fulfillment Associate

About the Position

Our client is a healthcare technology platform reimagining what dermatology should look like in the 21st century. Their vertically-integrated platform powers a bespoke experience for every patient, from digital diagnosis to medication delivery, to ongoing care. It is the only company to combine a nationwide network of dermatologists and a prescription compounding facility to provide world-class dermatology care at a fraction of the cost or hassle of the traditional healthcare system.

What we are looking for:
This is an excellent role for anyone interested in learning about or pursuing a career in Pharmaceuticals. We are looking for a dependable Shipping & Fulfillment Associate (Pharmacy Clerk) that will package and ship medications onsite at our fulfillment facility. You will undertake other tasks under the direction of a pharmacist to provide excellent work ethic and ensure packages are shipped quickly and safely. As a pharmacy clerk you must be detail-oriented and reliable since the job has high responsibility. You must also possess excellent communication skills.

You will:

  • Maintain speed and accuracy while processing medications for shipping
  • Maintain a clean & safe work environment in pharmacy facilities including cleaning labs
  • Communicates shipping room needs with delivery providers and pharmacy management
  • Ensuring medications are safely stored and handled.
  • Analyzes distribution and supports pharmacists and pharmacy technicians
  • You will work in an environment where the highest professional and ethical standards are maintained as well as full compliance with all Federal, State and Local laws and regulations

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
An an On-Site Account Manager, you will have full responsibility for all recruiting and operational functions for client sites operating in a 24/7 warehouse environment. This position is ideal for someone with a natural drive to lead, manage processes, and foster teamwork, along with the flexibility to adapt to dynamic client needs.

In this role, you'll cultivate relationships with our clients and lead a team to ensure staffing goals are met and operational excellence is achieved. You’ll work closely with centralized support units, building strong partnerships to meet business objectives. Success in this role requires a blend of customer focus, clear communication, and experience in guiding and developing teams to success. This position reports to a team director.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Recruit, train, and guide a team of hourly and internal staff to fulfill client staffing needs in a warehouse setting. Offer constructive feedback, develop performance improvement plans, and collaborate with HR to handle evaluations and disciplinary actions.
  • Track and analyze performance data using KPIs, reporting on daily, weekly, and monthly metrics. Identify continuous improvement areas to optimize efficiency and productivity.
  • Lead and measure community engagement initiatives for client sites to strengthen our network and resource pool.
  • Ensure consistency across locations by implementing standard work procedures and maintaining alignment with job function requirements.
  • Review recruiting activity, monitor market trends, and create action plans to enhance recruitment outcomes.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with clients to identify performance improvements, and develop strategies to strengthen the partnership.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional support teams to interpret data, assess trends, and communicate relevant results to the client.
  • Adhere to and uphold client safety standards and workplace policies.

Requirements:

  • Leadership Experience: Minimum of 4 years of progressive leadership experience with both hourly and salaried staff, preferably within a warehouse or staffing environment
  • Warehouse & Account Management Experience: At least 3 years of on-site warehouse management or account management experience in a client-facing role, with 2-3 years of experience collaborating with senior-level client contacts.
  • High-Volume Hiring Experience: Proven track record in high-volume recruiting for hourly roles.
  • Time Management & Organization: Strong skills in prioritizing, organizing, and tracking project details, with the ability to manage multiple projects with varying deadlines.
  • Process Focus: Experience in developing strategies that include visual controls, standard processes, and accountability measures.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Flexibility & Travel: Willingness to travel up to 25% based on business needs.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in Spanish and English is required (reading/writing/speaking)

Physical Demands:
This role may require hands-on support for warehouse operations, including driving machinery, directing facility flow, and performing physically demanding tasks such as lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling materials.

In this role, you’ll leverage a results-driven, collaborative style to build successful partnerships and drive consistent staffing excellence across locations. If you’re a motivated team player with a passion for people and process, we’d love to see you apply.

This is a 1st shift opportunity working Monday–Saturday with overtime required as dictated by production and facility needs. Pay is $28.00/hour (temporary) with the opportunity for $30.00/hour (permanent) based on conversion/offer.

Benefits are available through Integrity Staffing Solutions and may vary by assignment.

In this role, you’ll support continuous production by performing preventive and predictive maintenance, troubleshooting and repairing equipment, and maintaining facility systems in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. job.title: Sr. Onsite Account Manager
job.description:
As an Account Manager, you will have direct ownership and control of all client relations, recruiting and operations functions for client sites that operate in a 24/7 model.

You’ll manage the local relationship with our distribution center client and internal staffing teams. You’ll foster close relationships with centralized business support units. To be successful in this role you’ll need to be data driven with strong customer focus and experience with workforce teams of 100+.

What You’ll Bring:

Strong operational leadership experience in a high-volume warehouse, distribution center, or e-commerce environment, including management of a large hourly workforce. Experience managing temporary or contingent associates is a plus. Success requires strong client relationship skills, a metrics-driven approach, and the ability to adapt quickly, exercise sound judgment, and make strategic decisions as business needs change.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead operations in a 24x7 enviornment, aligning staffing levels, team performance, and service delivery with client volume, productivity expectations, and changing business priorities.
  • Hire, train, coach, and manage client-facing managers and hourly staff supporting recruiting and onsite operations. Build accountability through clear expectations, regular feedback, and development plans.
  • Build strong relationships with client leaders through daily communication, proactive problem-solving, and a thorough understanding of their operational goals.
  • Monitor and analyze key performance indicators, including fill rates, attendance, turnover, productivity, overtime, and client satisfaction. Translate results into clear action plans with measurable outcomes.
  • Anticipate staffing gaps, volume fluctuations, and operational challenges. Make timely, informed decisions about workforce deployment, recruiting priorities, and resource allocation.
  • Remain nimble in a fast-paced environment, adjusting plans quickly while balancing immediate operational demands with long-term client and business objectives.
  • Own recruiting, onboarding, onsite support, and associate engagement programs to maintain a dependable workforce and improve retention.
  • Evaluate recruiting pipelines and community outreach results to ensure hiring activity supports client demand across locations.
  • Establish consistent operating procedures across sites while adapting execution to each client’s requirements.
  • Conduct regular client business reviews, presenting performance trends, addressing concerns, and recommending improvements that strengthen service and the partnership.
  • Partner with HR on employee relations, performance evaluations, and corrective action, up to and including termination.
  • Collaborate with recruiting, HR, safety, and other support teams to resolve issues, interpret data, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Reinforce safety expectations and ensure teams follow client workplace policies and established procedures.


What you'll need:

  • Minimum of 4-years of progressive experience in leadership roles with P & L responsibilities, in a warehouse, e-commerce, manufacturing environment with client facing responsibilities of 100+
  • Fluent in Spanish/English (reading/writing/speaking) strongly preferred
  • Experience managing an hourly workforce in a warehouse environment
  • Experience with Bullhorn strongly preferred
  • Exceptional time management skills such as prioritizing/organizing and tracking details and meeting deadlines of multiple projects with varying completion dates
  • Strong process focus shown in examples of creating and driving strategies that include visual controls, standard accountability process and lead standard work.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills
  • Travel may be 25% + based upon business needs
  • Adhere to all client and ISS business ethics codes


Physical Demands: At times, you may be rolling up your sleeves and fulfilling orders for our customer experience driven clients. This may require that you perform anything from driving commercial machinery, directing facility parking, working in facility process paths, walking continuously and lifting, carrying, climbing steps, pushing, pulling materials or products.

About the Role

The Warehouse Associate (Line Associate) performs hands-on packaging/assembly work by placing pharmaceutical products into containers for shipment, inspecting for quality, labeling/coding packages, and supporting rework/counting tasks as needed.

job.title: Manipuladores de Paquetes - Bono de $1,000
job.description:
¡OnTrac está contratando manipuladores de paquetes de temporada en Dayton, Nueva Jersey! Si deseas formar parte de una empresa en crecimiento donde puedas aprender, trabajar con dedicación y marcar la diferencia, nos encantaría ponerte en contacto con un reclutador. Este es un puesto de contratación directa por temporada con un pago de hasta $23.50 por hora*. Además, ¡se ofrece un bono de $1,000 al finalizar la temporada a todos los candidatos que completen satisfactoriamente su asignación**! ¡Posibles oportunidades laborales después de la temporada*!


¡EVENTO DE CONTRATACIÓN SIN CITA PREVIA!
Fecha: Del lunes 16 de noviembre al viernes 20 de noviembre
Horario: 8:30 a. m. a 5:00 p. m.
Dirección del evento: 2270 US-130, Dayton, NJ 08810


Beneficios

  • Seguro médico y dental
  • Planes de beneficios complementarios
  • Plan 401(k) con aportaciones equivalentes de la empresa
  • Programa de bonos por recomendar candidatos (hasta $500)
  • Licencia por enfermedad remunerada (según las normas locales y estatales)
  • Pago adicional por horas trabajadas en días festivos
  • Programa de Asistencia al Empleado (EAP)


Acerca del puesto

Como manipulador de paquetes, serás una parte fundamental de nuestro equipo de almacén y ayudarás a garantizar que los paquetes se descarguen, clasifiquen y carguen de manera eficiente y segura. Trabajarás en un entorno de apoyo que destaca la seguridad, el trabajo en equipo y la excelencia operativa, manipulando los paquetes con cuidado y precisión.

Pago: hasta $23.50 por hora* + ¡bono de $1,000 al finalizar la temporada**!

*Tarifa de pago de temporada: del 7 de noviembre de 2026 al 31 de diciembre de 2026.
**Duración de la temporada: del 31 de octubre de 2026 al 31 de diciembre de 2026. Pueden aplicarse términos y condiciones adicionales.


Turnos disponibles

Este puesto reúne los requisitos para recibir pago por horas extras de acuerdo con la legislación aplicable.

  • Lunes a jueves, de 4:00 a. m. a 12:30 p. m.
  • Viernes a domingo, de 4:00 a. m. a 12:30 p. m.
  • Viernes a domingo, de 1:00 p. m. a 11:00 p. m.

Los horarios pueden variar según las necesidades de la empresa. El «fin de la clasificación» se define como la finalización de todas las tareas de clasificación requeridas para el día y las actividades de limpieza, según las indicaciones de la gerencia del centro.


Responsabilidades principales

  • Dar prioridad a la seguridad siguiendo todos los protocolos y procedimientos de seguridad.
  • Descargar remolques y clasificar paquetes por código postal.
  • Cargar los camiones de reparto para las rutas de salida.
  • Ayudar con la clasificación diaria y las tareas de limpieza del almacén.
  • Utilizar equipos de almacén, como carros, transpaletas y contenedores, para mover paquetes de hasta 75 libras.


Requisitos principales

  • Tener al menos 18 años.
  • Poder levantar, empujar, jalar y mover artículos de un peso promedio de 50 libras, y levantar ocasionalmente hasta 75 libras.
  • Contar con transporte confiable y vivir a una distancia aproximada de 15 millas del lugar de trabajo.
  • Tener conocimientos básicos de inglés, tanto oral como escrito.
  • Sentirse cómodo trabajando en un almacén con temperaturas variables.
  • Se prefiere experiencia previa en almacenes, que demuestre capacidad para levantar objetos pesados y trabajar en operaciones de ritmo acelerado.
  • Contar con autorización válida para trabajar y estar dispuesto a someterse a pruebas de detección de drogas y verificaciones de antecedentes penales.

¡Encuentra tu próxima oportunidad! Si estás listo para unirte a nuestro equipo, ¡SOLICITA AHORA y comienza a trabajar pronto!

Empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades

OnTrac se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos la diversidad y aceptamos solicitudes de personas de todos los orígenes, capacidades y experiencias. No discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, discapacidad o edad.

Lasership, Inc., que opera bajo el nombre comercial OnTrac Final Mile, junto con sus empresas afiliadas, incluida OnTrac Logistics, Inc. (denominadas conjuntamente «OnTrac» o la «Empresa»), es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades.

job.title: Account Manager - Bilingual
job.description:
As an Account Manager, you will have direct ownership and control of all client relations, recruiting and operations functions for client sites that operate in a 24/7 model.

You’ll manage the local relationship with our distribution center client and internal staffing teams. You’ll foster close relationships with centralized business support units. To be successful in this role you’ll need to be data driven with strong customer focus and experience with workforce teams of 100+.

This role requires fluency in Spanish & English (reading/writing/speaking).

What you'll do:

  • Hire, train, manage, and motivate a team of client-facing managers and hourly staff supporting client needs for both recruiting and client onsite roles in multiple locations.
  • Provide ongoing feedback and development plans for staff to support their success. Partner with HR to complete employee evaluations and to issue disciplinary action, when needed, up to and including termination
  • Track and maintain the performance and effectiveness of your sites via established KPI’s and daily, weekly and monthly reports. Identify areas of opportunity for continuous improvement to established KPI’s.
  • Drive continual community engagement activity for client sites; measure and report on results.
  • Drive consistency in standard work across all locations and job functions
  • Create, review, and provide critical analysis of recruiting activity for the market, devise action plans for continuous improvement.
  • Ownership of recruiting, onsite, candidate, and associate programs and initiatives
  • Monitor, report and conduct business reviews with clients to improve performance, identify areas to be stronger partners, and enhance our overall partnership.
  • Leverage cross-functional support teams to solicit and interpret various data streams, and communicate business results and trends that relate to the client
  • Obey all the safety and workplace policies of our client while on their premises.


What you'll need:

  • Minimum of 4-years of progressive experience in leadership roles with P & L responsibilities, in a warehouse, e-commerce, manufacturing environment with client facing responsibilities of 100+
  • Fluent in Spanish/English (reading/writing/speaking)
  • Experience managing an hourly workforce
  • Experience with Bullhorn strongly preferred
  • Exceptional time management skills such as prioritizing/organizing and tracking details and meeting deadlines of multiple projects with varying completion dates
  • Strong process focus shown in examples of creating and driving strategies that include visual controls, standard accountability process and lead standard work.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills

Physical Demands: At times, you may be rolling up your sleeves and fulfilling orders for our customer experience driven clients. This may require that you perform anything from driving commercial machinery, directing facility parking, working in facility process paths, walking continuously and lifting, carrying, climbing steps, pushing, pulling materials or products.

  • Support other teams as priorities change

  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written procedures
  • Basic math skills (weights, measurements, counts)
  • Ability to read/write English well enough to follow instructions and complete records
  • Willingness to follow strict hygiene/gowning rules (ex: no jewelry/nail polish/outside food in production areas)
  • Ability to stand for most of an 8-hour shift; repetitive hand motions
  • Ability to bend/reach and lift up to 50 lbs (and more with team lift/equipment)

job.title: HR Generalist
job.description:
HR Business Partner

Bilingual English/Spanish required

Location: Remote within Texas, Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Pennsylvania, Delaware or New Jersey

Travel: Onsite visits to client locations as needed

Required: Experience supporting a high volume hourly workforce in manufacturing or distribution; fluency in English and Spanish

Position Summary

Join our team as support our temporary hourly associates, internal staff and leadership teams. In this role, you will address workplace concerns, conduct investigations, coach leaders, and help ensure consistent application of company policies across multiple client locations.

This position requires someone who understands the pace and demands of manufacturing or distribution environments and can build trust with associates, onsite teams, and client managers.

While the role is remote but may require travel to client sites is required as needed to conduct investigations and provide onsite support.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a primary resource for employee relations concerns involving a high volume hourly workforce across multiple client locations.
  • Communicate directly with associates in English and Spanish to understand concerns, explain processes, and support resolution.
  • Conduct timely, thorough, and impartial investigations into workplace concerns, including complaints involving conduct, harassment, discrimination, attendance, and policy violations.
  • Interview associates and managers, gather statements, review supporting records, and prepare clear, objective investigation summaries.
  • Recommend appropriate resolutions and corrective actions.
  • Coach onsite leaders on documentation, performance management, conflict resolution, and consistent policy application.
  • Manage employee relations requests through Nitro ticketing system, prioritizing urgent issues and maintaining accurate case notes and follow-up.
  • Maintain confidential records and document relevant activity in HR systems and Bullhorn, as applicable.
  • Identify recurring concerns and recommend improvements to communication, training, associate engagement, and retention.
  • Collaborate with client managers and internal operations teams to resolve concerns while maintaining strong working relationships.
  • Travel to client locations as needed for investigations, associate meetings, and operational support.

Required Qualifications

  • Prior employee relations experience supporting a high volume hourly workforce in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to conduct interviews, explain policies, and communicate clearly in both languages.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting workplace investigations and documenting findings.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.
  • Experience advising managers on employee concerns, performance issues, and corrective action.
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple cases and competing priorities.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting while remaining responsive to associates and business partners.
  • Residence in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, or Maryland, with the ability to travel to client sites as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Nitro ticketing and Bullhorn.
  • Experience in staffing or supporting hourly associates across multiple client sites.
  • Experience supporting multiple shifts or 24/7 operations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Pay: $65,000-$72,000

Medical/Dental/Vision coverage

Paid holidays, paid time off and personal time

job.title: Warehouse
job.description:
Buscamos personas responsables y detallistas para unirse al equipo de preparación de pedidos en New Castle. En este puesto, ayudarás a preparar los pedidos de los clientes y a manejar los productos de cerámica con cuidado para que lleguen de forma segura a su destino.

Funciones y responsabilidades

Preparación de pedidos

  • Localizar y seleccionar los productos y cantidades correctos para cada pedido.
  • Manejar con cuidado los productos de cerámica para evitar daños.
  • Registrar en la documentación de envío la cantidad de líneas y piezas seleccionadas, tus iniciales y la fecha.
  • Completar correctamente el informe de productividad de preparación de pedidos.
  • Informar al supervisor de cualquier diferencia en la ubicación de los productos.

Empaque

  • Empacar los pedidos de manera cuidadosa y segura para su envío.
  • Verificar que los productos y las cantidades coincidan con la información del pedido.
  • Registrar en la documentación de envío la cantidad de líneas y pedidos empacados, tus iniciales y la fecha.
  • Completar correctamente el informe de productividad de empaque.
  • Informar al supervisor sobre cualquier problema con el empaque.

Requisitos

  • Atención a los detalles y capacidad para trabajar con precisión.
  • Capacidad para manejar productos frágiles con cuidado.
  • Habilidades básicas de lectura, conteo y documentación.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo.
  • Responsabilidad y actitud positiva.
  • Experiencia previa en almacén, preparación de pedidos o empaque es una ventaja.

job.title: Staffing Specialist
job.description:
Staffing Specialist

Job Summary:
This role is perfect for you to start your career in HR!

The successful candidate will be outgoing and ambitious, establish rapport with candidates, the onsite team and the client quickly, have a passion for recruiting and the desire to be successful.

This position will play an integral role in helping to meet the demands of our client’s temporary staffing needs

This is a temporary role, role requires you to work in person at our client warehouse. and travel to client sites as needed.
Fluency in Spanish and English required (reading/writing/speaking).

Pay Rate: $25 per hour

What you’ll do:

  • Review resumes, schedule interviews for entry level positions for a variety of roles and clients.
  • Ensure candidates are aware of job requirements, pay rate, schedule and are appropriately assigned in all systems
  • Coordinate between candidates and hiring managers or clients and managing Bullhorn/ATS.
  • Responsible for payroll coordination from client to central team, all internal compliance items such as background check and drug testing.

job.title: Warehouse associate
job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking dependable, hardworking Warehouse Associates to support fast-paced warehouse operations. The primary responsibility of this position is to quickly and efficiently unload incoming shipments while maintaining accuracy and safety. Additional duties include assembling shelving units, sorting materials, and transporting products using manual hand pallet jacks. This is a physically demanding, hands-on role that requires a strong work ethic, urgency, and teamwork.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prioritize fast, efficient unloading of incoming trucks and shipments to ensure warehouse operations remain on schedule.
  • Work with team members to unload materials quickly while handling products safely and minimizing damage.
  • Sort, separate, and organize incoming shipments into designated warehouse areas.
  • Operate manual hand pallet jacks to move pallets, shelving components, and other materials.
  • Assemble shelving units, storage racks, and fixtures using manual assembly methods.
  • Follow basic assembly instructions to ensure shelving units are constructed accurately.
  • Inspect incoming materials and assembled products for damage, defects, or missing components.
  • Stage and organize materials for assembly, storage, or distribution.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Assist with additional warehouse responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications

  • Previous warehouse, truck unloading, assembly, or general labor experience preferred.
  • Ability to maintain a fast, consistent work pace during unloading operations.
  • Experience operating manual hand pallet jacks preferred.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform repetitive physical tasks.
  • Comfortable standing, walking, bending, lifting, pushing, and pulling throughout the shift.
  • Ability to follow instructions and work efficiently with a team.
  • Strong attendance, punctuality, and reliability.
  • Good attention to detail and commitment to workplace safety.
  • No power tool experience required.

Physical Requirements

This position requires continuous physical activity, including repetitive lifting, carrying, bending, pushing, pulling, and unloading materials. Associates must be comfortable working at a steady, fast pace throughout their shift while following proper safety procedures.

Ideal Candidate

A motivated, physically capable individual who understands the importance of speed, efficiency, and teamwork when unloading trucks. The ideal candidate can transition between unloading, sorting, shelving assembly, and material handling while maintaining productivity and accuracy.

job.title: Production Manager
job.description:
Now hiring a Production Manager in Suwanee, GA for a full-time, on-site, direct-hire opportunity. This is a Monday–Friday day shift (7:00 AM–5:00 PM) role with annual salary targeted at $90,000–$110,000 (DOE)—ideal for a hands-on manufacturing leader with strong CNC/precision metal manufacturing experience who enjoys driving production efficiency, quality, and team performance.

About the Role

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking an experienced, hands-on Production Manager to lead day-to-day manufacturing operations for a precision manufacturing environment. You’ll oversee production scheduling, team leadership, continuous improvement initiatives, and delivery/quality performance across machining and metal manufacturing processes.

Pay Rate:

  • $90,000–$110,000 annually (depending on experience and qualifications)

Available Shift Times

  • Oversee daily manufacturing operations to meet production schedules, quality standards, and deadlines

job.title: Onsite Account Manager -Bilingual (Spanish)
job.description:
As an Account Manager, you will have direct ownership and control of all client relations, recruiting and operations functions for client sites that operate in a 24/7 model.

You’ll manage the local relationship with our distribution center client and internal staffing teams. You’ll foster close relationships with centralized business support units. To be successful in this role you’ll need to be data driven with strong customer focus and experience with workforce teams of 100+.

What You’ll Bring:

Strong operational leadership experience in a high-volume warehouse, distribution center, or e-commerce environment, including management of a large hourly workforce. Experience managing temporary or contingent associates is a plus. Success requires strong client relationship skills, a metrics-driven approach, and the ability to adapt quickly, exercise sound judgment, and make strategic decisions as business needs change.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead operations in a 24x7 enviornment, aligning staffing levels, team performance, and service delivery with client volume, productivity expectations, and changing business priorities.
  • Hire, train, coach, and manage client-facing managers and hourly staff supporting recruiting and onsite operations. Build accountability through clear expectations, regular feedback, and development plans.
  • Build strong relationships with client leaders through daily communication, proactive problem-solving, and a thorough understanding of their operational goals.
  • Monitor and analyze key performance indicators, including fill rates, attendance, turnover, productivity, overtime, and client satisfaction. Translate results into clear action plans with measurable outcomes.
  • Anticipate staffing gaps, volume fluctuations, and operational challenges. Make timely, informed decisions about workforce deployment, recruiting priorities, and resource allocation.
  • Remain nimble in a fast-paced environment, adjusting plans quickly while balancing immediate operational demands with long-term client and business objectives.
  • Own recruiting, onboarding, onsite support, and associate engagement programs to maintain a dependable workforce and improve retention.
  • Evaluate recruiting pipelines and community outreach results to ensure hiring activity supports client demand across locations.
  • Establish consistent operating procedures across sites while adapting execution to each client’s requirements.
  • Conduct regular client business reviews, presenting performance trends, addressing concerns, and recommending improvements that strengthen service and the partnership.
  • Partner with HR on employee relations, performance evaluations, and corrective action, up to and including termination.
  • Collaborate with recruiting, HR, safety, and other support teams to resolve issues, interpret data, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Reinforce safety expectations and ensure teams follow client workplace policies and established procedures.


What you'll need:

  • Minimum of 4-years of progressive experience in leadership roles with P & L responsibilities, in a warehouse, e-commerce, manufacturing environment with client facing responsibilities of 100+
  • Fluent in Spanish/English (reading/writing/speaking) strongly preferred
  • Experience managing an hourly workforce in a warehouse environment
  • Experience with Bullhorn strongly preferred
  • Exceptional time management skills such as prioritizing/organizing and tracking details and meeting deadlines of multiple projects with varying completion dates
  • Strong process focus shown in examples of creating and driving strategies that include visual controls, standard accountability process and lead standard work.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills
  • Travel may be 25% + based upon business needs
  • Adhere to all client and ISS business ethics codes


Physical Demands: At times, you may be rolling up your sleeves and fulfilling orders for our customer experience driven clients. This may require that you perform anything from driving commercial machinery, directing facility parking, working in facility process paths, walking continuously and lifting, carrying, climbing steps, pushing, pulling materials or products.

job.title: Lead RPO Specialist - Recruiting
job.description:
Lead RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing) Specialist – Field Team

We are looking for customer service-oriented people to work in our offices and staff hiring events throughout the country. If you are bi-lingual that’s a PLUS!

Pay rate: $21.50 per hour


Job Description:

  • Manage the candidate experience, whether they are being interviewed, hired, or considered for the job.
  • Provide excellent customer service to all applicants - ensuring they feel welcomed and valued throughout the process.
  • Share pertinent information with applicants including information regarding client roles available, policies, expectations, and requirements
  • Ensure that all client hiring processes are complete and in compliance per client guidelines, including applicable interview process, administering oral drug tests, collecting information such as ID and education, and completing an I-9 to verify work authorization
  • Verify that each applicant knows all of the necessary details for their assignment
  • Perform all required data entry in our client systems playing close attention to detail in a high-volume environment
  • Work effectively across a variety of communication channels: in-person, phone, email, live chat, social media, etc. with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and respect.
  • Delight candidates during every service interaction.
  • Work collaboratively with teammates to solve customer issues as quickly and efficiently as possible
  • Engage future potential talent through talent communities and talent pipelines
  • Build sustainable relationships of trust through open and interactive communication
  • Handle complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives
  • Assist in defining goals for the team and building a strategy to attain them
  • Track and approve hours worked for team members
  • Lead by example – inspire your team to put their best foot forward by embodying what you expect.
  • Other job functions as business demands


Requirements:

  • 3-5 years customer service experience in retail, recruiting or the hospitality industry
  • Bilingual in Spanish is a plus but not required
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience leading a team of at least 3 staff members
  • Heavy focus on following standard work and quality control with all processes
  • High-level comfort using online software, webcams and scanners
  • Focus on customer service ensuring a positive experience at all times
  • Ability to stay calm when under pressure or dealing with challenging situations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to speak professionally with candidates, staff, and clients. (Bi-lingual skills a plus)
  • Ability to work extended hours and/or Saturday/Sunday to meet business needs
  • In person attendance and the ability to work overtime as needed is required. This role cannot be remote

job.title: Gear Manufacturing Lead 1st Shift
job.description:
CNC Manufacturing Lead – Gear Experience Required
Position Title: Manufacturing Lead – Gear & CNC Operations
Location: Suwanee, GA
Department: Manufacturing / Production
Shift: 1st Shift
Hours: Monday – Friday from 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM
Pay Rate: $25 - $27/hour
Position Summary
Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking an experienced Manufacturing Lead with a strong background in gear manufacturing, CNC machining, and production operations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting CNC machinery, knowledge of gear production processes, and the ability to lead and motivate a manufacturing team.
This individual will oversee daily production activities, ensure quality standards are met, monitor workflow, and assist with training and coaching employees to maintain a safe, productive, and efficient manufacturing environment.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate daily manufacturing and production activities.
  • Oversee employees and ensure production schedules and deadlines are met.
  • Provide hands-on support with CNC machines and gear manufacturing equipment.
  • Set up, operate, and troubleshoot CNC machinery as needed.
  • Monitor gear manufacturing processes to ensure accuracy and quality.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and manufacturing specifications.
  • Perform quality inspections using precision measuring instruments.
  • Identify production issues and implement corrective actions.
  • Monitor machine performance and minimize downtime.
  • Train, coach, and support production employees.
  • Ensure employees follow safety procedures and standard operating practices.
  • Maintain accurate production records and communicate daily production updates to management.
  • Assist with workflow improvements, efficiency, and waste reduction.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous manufacturing or production leadership experience.
  • Hands-on experience with CNC machinery and machining operations.
  • Knowledge of gear manufacturing, gear cutting, or gear production processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings.
  • Experience using precision measuring tools such as calipers and micrometers.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing quality standards and safety procedures.
  • Ability to troubleshoot equipment and identify production problems.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a CNC machining or gear manufacturing team.
  • Knowledge of CNC programming, machine setup, and tooling.
  • Experience with gear cutting, grinding, hobbing, or inspection processes.
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing and continuous improvement practices.
  • Previous experience training and developing manufacturing employees.

Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who understands both the technical and operational sides of production. They should be comfortable working directly with CNC equipment, have knowledge of gear manufacturing, and demonstrate the ability to lead a team while maintaining productivity, quality, and safety standards.
Key Skills

  • CNC Machining
  • Gear Manufacturing
  • Production Leadership
  • Machine Setup & Troubleshooting
  • Blueprint Reading
  • Quality Control & Inspection
  • Team Training & Development
  • Production Scheduling
  • Manufacturing Operations
  • Safety Compliance

job.title: Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento
job.description:
Ahora estamos contratando un Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento en Atlanta, GA. Este puesto ofrece variedad de turnos y paga $16.00 por hora más horas extra, con ingresos de 900 a 1000 dólares o más por semana! La tarifa de pago aumentará una vez que se formalice la contratación. El puesto se enfoca en crear espacios limpios y listos para recibir a los huéspedes, y se prefiere experiencia previa en limpieza de hoteles. Se anima a postularse a candidatos responsables, detallistas y que se enorgullezcan de realizar un trabajo de calidad.


Beneficios

  • Pago competitivo de $16.00 por hora /$900-$1000+ por semana. La tarifa de pago aumentará una vez que se formalice la contratación.
  • Opciones de turnos consistentes y oportunidades de horas extras
  • Ambiente de trabajo de apoyo


Acerca del Puesto
Como Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento, su responsabilidad principal será mantener los estándares de limpieza en las habitaciones de los huéspedes y las áreas comunes. Usted desempeñará un papel fundamental en la creación de un ambiente acogedor e higiénico para los huéspedes, realizando tareas como tender camas, desinfectar baños, quitar el polvo de las superficies y reponer suministros. También ayudará con la limpieza de pasillos, salones de reuniones y otras áreas según sea necesario, siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos de seguridad y saneamiento.


Pago: $16.00 por hora


Horarios de Turnos Disponibles
Varios turnos disponibles, incluyendo opciones durante el día y la tarde/noche, con posibilidad de horas extras según la ocupación del hotel.


Responsabilidades Principales

  • Limpiar y preparar las habitaciones de los huéspedes de acuerdo con los estándares de calidad
  • Tender camas, cambiar la ropa de cama y organizar las habitaciones
  • Desinfectar baños y superficies de alto contacto
  • Quitar el polvo, aspirar, barrer y trapear los pisos
  • Retirar la basura y reponer los suministros
  • Inspeccionar las habitaciones terminadas para asegurarse de que estén listas para recibir a los huéspedes
  • Reportar problemas de mantenimiento o daños
  • Ayudar con la limpieza de áreas comunes y pasillos según sea necesario


Requisitos Principales

  • Se prefiere ampliamente experiencia previa en limpieza de hoteles o limpieza profesional
  • Gran atención a los detalles y orgullo por la calidad del trabajo realizado
  • Capacidad para trabajar eficientemente en un ambiente de ritmo rápido
  • Asistencia confiable y puntualidad
  • Capacidad para realizar tareas físicas, incluyendo estar de pie, caminar, agacharse y levantar objetos
  • Flexibilidad de horario según las necesidades del hotel

job.title: Flexible Staffing Assistant (RPO)
job.description:
Staffing Assistant (On Demand, Temporary)

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a customer service-oriented individual to work in our offices and staff hiring events. In this role, you will support the hiring process by completing pre-hire paperwork and screening activities while providing customer service to the candidates visiting the office. This is a great entry-level position in a fast-paced environment that will give you insight and experience into the staffing world.

Pay Rate: $15.00 ( $16 seasonal pay rate 9/14/2026 to 12/19/2026) returning to $15.00/hr 12/20/2026

Job Type:This is a temporary On Demand role. The schedule will vary and is determined based on business need and when hiring events are scheduled. Availability of hours will vary week-to-week.

  • On Demand hours vary depending on the week and time of year

The ideal candidate should have the ability to travel to support other locations as needed; Chester and occasionally Petersburg.

Bilingual is a PLUS!

Requirements:

  • Comfortable utilizing online software, cameras, scanners, and mobile devices.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and the ability to learn other platforms.
  • Comfortable working across multiple screens and computer systems simultaneously.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle challenging situations, and multitask in a high-volume, ever-changing environment.
  • Ability to professionally communicate, prioritizing tact and confidentiality with candidates, staff, and clients, and willingness to present to large groups.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet business demands.
  • Preferred customer service experience in retail, recruiting, hospitality industry, or other fast-paced, customer-oriented environments.
  • Must uphold a high level of integrity in handling confidential information and adhere to standard work instructions for all processes.
  • High school diploma or GED is required.
  • In-person attendance and the ability to work overtime as necessary are mandatory. This role cannot be performed remotely.

Job Description:

  • Guide candidates through pre-hire onboarding activities, ensuring a smooth understanding of the hiring process. Deliver exceptional customer service to all applicants, fostering a sense of welcome and value throughout hiring events and community outreach activities.
  • Assist candidates to guarantee an accurate and seamless onboarding process, verifying the completion of all application and pre-hire tasks promptly and accurately through the Applicant Tracking System and other technologies.
  • Ensure all client hiring procedures are fully executed and compliant with client guidelines, encompassing data entry, application review, validation of work authorization documentation, badge photo capture, drug screening administration, and other assigned duties.
  • Utilize effective communication to ensure applicants understand job details and have all questions and obstacles addressed and resolved prior to departing the recruiting office.
  • Meet critical deadlines for completing pre-hire activities within client systems, maintaining meticulous attention to detail in a high-volume and fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate effectively across various channels including in-person interactions, phone calls, emails, live chats, etc., with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction and respect.

job.title: Warehouse Shift Lead
job.description:
Our Shift Leads are energetic, decisive, and engaging while managing multiple priorities in a changing warehouse environment.

Shift Leads are responsible for all day-to-day operations taking place on their scheduled shift for our temporary workforce at our client location.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Weekly paychecks
  • Opportunity to earn OT
  • Benefits from day one - Medical, dental and vision, including Telemedicine!
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program

Location: Moreland, GA

Shift; Mon-Fri 6:30pm-3am Pay Rate: $26/hr.
Shift: Wed-Sat 6:30am-5pm Pay Rate: $25/hr.

Essential Functions
An individual must be able to successfully perform the essential functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Coordinate and manage large group meetings for hourly associates, including first-day Welcome Meeting.
  • Provide performance feedback and disciplinary action, including terminations, for hourly associates.
  • Communicate and audit adherence to safety and employee relations policies, investigate complaints or deviations from policy, and make recommendations for corrective action as needed.
  • Maintain appropriate levels of confidentiality, while managing workflow for company and onsite client projects.
  • Build Relationships with Client managers through daily interaction and weekly meetings. Solicit their input of hourly associate performance and department concerns. Provide them with the guidance and support needed to ensure your partnership is contributing to their success.
  • Maintain open door policy with hourly associates, answering questions regarding policies and procedures, actively listening of concerns and issues raised, escalating issues as appropriate, and maintaining confidential conversations.

Preferred Minimum Requirements

  • HS Diploma or GED
  • Bilingual in Spanish/English required
  • 3+ years supervisory experience in a warehouse environment, large group experience a plus
  • Experience in client relations, preferably in warehouse or staffing environment
  • Superior customer service, organization and time management skills
  • Advanced level Microsoft Excel and Web-based Applications/Systems
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate and problem solve in a fast paced, and fluid environment
  • Ability to adjust schedule for work overtime and be present during changing business needs
  • Desire to learn and develop beyond current role
  • Ability to work onsite at Client location and adjust schedule based on business needs.

Physical Requirements:

  • Lift up to 49 pounds
  • Push utility cards up to 60 pounds
  • Use carts, dollies, hand trucks and other gear to move items around
  • Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  • Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  • Stand or walk your entire shift

job.title: Forklift Operators
job.description:
Now hiring Forklift Operators in Aurora, with various shift options offering a new seasonal pay rate of up to $23.25/hour*. Whether you're looking for a evening shift or a daytime schedule, this opportunity is perfect for those seeking stable work in a fast-paced logistics environment. No experience required - training will be provided.


WALK-IN HIRING EVENT!
Date: Monday, November 9th through Saturday, November 14th
Time: Mon-Fri 8:00am-4:30pm | Sat 8:00am-1:00pm
Event Address: 400 Smoke Tree Plaza, Ste 100, North Aurora, IL 60542

Benefits

  • Opportunity to develop essential warehouse and material handling skills
  • Stable and consistent schedule
  • Work in a dynamic team-focused environment


About the Role
As a Warehouse Associate, you'll be manually loading and unloading freight, sorting, stacking, and securing items onto pallets, assisting with basic assembly tasks, and moving inventory throughout the facility using manual or electric pallet jacks. You’ll also be responsible for maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment.


Seasonal Pay Rate: Up to $23.25/hour*
*Season Duration: 10/25/2026 to 1/2/2027


Available Shift Times:

  • Sunday to Thursday, 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Tuesday to Saturday, 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Sunday to Thursday, 4:00 PM – 12:30 AM
  • Tuesday to Saturday, 4:00 PM – 12:30 AM


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate a forklift, electric pallet jack, pacer or other machinery used for transporting or shipping goods.
  • Load, unload, pack, and unpack stock of product or pallets from incoming vehicles.
  • Transport, retrieve and/or relocate stock of product or pallets to workstations or other assigned locations within the warehouse.
  • Label and sort incoming and outgoing shipments.
  • Monitor and maintain inventory of incoming and outgoing items.
  • Inspecting equipment before and after use to ensure it's in good working order.
  • Identifying damages and reporting shortages or quality deficiencies.
  • Cleaning equipment after use and disposing of any collected scraps or waste.
  • Carefully handle and dispose of hazardous waste materials whenever necessary.
  • Adhere to health and safety regulations and company policies.
  • This role includes responsibility for ensuring products are handled, stored, and distributed in a manner that maintains their safety, quality, and legality. Team members are expected to follow all standard operating procedures, report any concerns related to product condition or integrity, support traceability through accurate record-keeping, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and product safety awareness.
  • Other duties/responsibilities as necessary.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in operating forklifts, stand-up/reach, order/cherry/stock picker, pallet riders (walkie/EPJ) preferred.
  • Experience working in a warehouse environment
  • Ability to lift and move up to 75 lbs. regularly
  • Dependable transportation
  • Ability to work full-time with a flexible schedule
  • Provide own clothing (jeans, collared shirt, closed-toed shoes)
  • Enjoy working in a team and following instructions

job.title: Warehouse Yard Jockey
job.description:
Job Summary

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a safety-focused and dependable Yard Jockey to support daily warehouse and transportation operations within a private, self-contained facility yard. The Yard Jockey is responsible for the safe and efficient movement of trailers, yard equipment, and company assets between dock doors, staging areas, and assigned yard locations.

Pay and Shift:
$26 per hour
Sun-Wed - 11am-9:30pm
Wed-Sat - 11am-9:30pm

This position operates exclusively on private facility property. There is no public roadway, highway, over-the-road, or overnight driving required.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Yard & Trailer Operations

  • Safely move trailers and company equipment throughout the facility yard as directed by Operations, Transportation, and Warehouse leadership
  • Spot trailers accurately at dock doors, staging areas, and designated yard locations
  • Pull trailers from dock doors only after confirming all required safety and release procedures have been completed
  • Stage trailers to dock doors in alignment with operational needs and dock assignments
  • Maintain constant awareness of yard traffic, pedestrians, dock activity, and equipment movement
  • Operate yard truck/yard goat/hostler/yard tractor in accordance with company safety standards
  • Follow all trailer docking and releasing procedures, including required Trailer Dock Release coordination
  • Maintain safe speeds, use horn signals as required, and stop for pedestrians or unsafe yard conditions

Equipment Inspections & Safety

  • Complete pre-shift inspections of the yard truck prior to beginning trailer moves
  • Inspect key equipment components (brakes, steering, tires, lights, mirrors, horn, backup alarm, fifth wheel, air lines, electrical connections, and fuel/charge level)
  • Perform visual trailer inspections before coupling (landing gear, tires, rear doors, trailer frame, undercarriage, and visible damage)
  • Confirm trailers are safe to move before coupling or relocating
  • Perform proper coupling/uncoupling procedures (fifth wheel lock confirmation, air line + electrical connection, landing gear operation, tug test)
  • Report unsafe equipment, trailer damage, defects, near-misses, incidents, or yard hazards immediately
  • Remove unsafe equipment from operation when required and notify the appropriate supervisor/manager

Communication & Coordination

  • Communicate clearly with Dock Clerks, Dock Supervisors, Transportation, Warehouse, and Operations teams
  • Confirm trailer number, origin, and destination prior to each move
  • Notify the appropriate team member when each move is complete
  • Escalate blocked doors, damaged trailers, unclear instructions, equipment issues, or safety concerns before proceeding
  • Use a two-way radio throughout the shift and maintain professional radio communication
  • Serve as a key liaison between Transportation and Warehouse teams to support trailer flow, dock availability, and operational priorities

Compliance & Yard Safety

  • Follow all company yard safety policies, OSHA-aligned safety practices, and site-specific procedures
  • Wear required PPE (high-visibility safety vest and safety-toe footwear)
  • Carry and monitor an active, charged radio while working in the yard
  • Yield to pedestrians at all times and maintain safe separation from people, vehicles, trailers, dock doors, and fixed structures
  • Use a ground guide when required or when visibility is obstructed
  • Stop work and notify management immediately in the event of an incident, near-miss, collision, equipment damage, or unsafe condition

What You’ll Need (Required Qualifications)

  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL A)
  • Active/current DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate (Medical Card)
  • Prior experience operating commercial vehicles, yard trucks, yard goats, hostlers, or similar equipment
  • Ability to safely couple, move, spot, and uncouple trailers in a yard/warehouse environment
  • Ability to complete required Trailer Docking and Releasing Safety Program upon hire
  • Forklift certification or ability to obtain certification on Pacer and Electric Pallet Jack equipment (including single/double pallet jack operation)
  • Strong understanding of yard safety, trailer movement, backing procedures, dock operations, and equipment inspections
  • Ability to communicate clearly over radio and follow verbal instructions accurately
  • Must be dependable, safety-conscious, detail-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced logistics environment

Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Previous yard jockey/hostler/spotter/CDL driver experience, dock operations, warehouse, logistics, transportation, or trailer spotting experience
  • Completion of an accredited CDL truck driving program
  • Vocational training/coursework in logistics, transportation, heavy equipment operations, supply chain, or related field
  • Experience in fulfillment, distribution, transportation, or warehouse operations
  • Familiarity with trailer docking, trailer release procedures, dock safety, and yard management practices

Physical & Work Environment

  • Ability to work in an active outdoor yard and warehouse environment
  • Ability to climb in/out of yard trucks and trailers as needed
  • Ability to walk the yard, inspect equipment, connect/disconnect air lines and electrical cords, and operate landing gear
  • Ability to work in varying weather and lighting conditions (rain, heat, cold, low-light operations)
  • Ability to wear required PPE for the duration of the shift
  • Ability to remain alert and focused while operating equipment around pedestrians, dock doors, trailers, and moving vehicles

Why Work With Integrity Staffing Solutions

At Integrity Staffing Solutions, we put people first. We help associates find the right opportunity, succeed on the job, and grow their careers—backed by a team that supports you every step of the way.

Benefits

Eligible associates may have access to benefits such as:

  • Medical, dental, and vision options
  • Paid time off and holiday pay (where applicable)
  • Career advancement and training opportunities
  • Referral programs (where available)

(If you have a standard “day-one benefits” paragraph you prefer, paste it and I’ll swap it in.)

Pre-Employment / Work Authorization (Standard Evergreen Language)

  • Candidates must be able to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States.
  • This role may require successful completion of worksite-specific screening, which can include background check and/or drug screening based on client or site requirements.

AI-Assisted Hiring Notice (Requested)

Integrity Staffing Solutions may use AI-assisted tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as helping review application information, evaluating job-related skills, and improving recruiting efficiency. These tools are used to support—not replace—human decision-making. All final hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams.

job.description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Maintenance Team Lead to join our Reliability Department. This key role is responsible for leading a team of maintenance technicians and ensuring our production equipment and facilities operate safely and efficiently.

Ready to lead and make a real impact? Apply today to join a team where your skills and leadership will be valued!

Pay: $36 – $38 per hour
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM

Snapshot of a Day-in-the-Life:

  • Lead, direct, and support maintenance team members during the afternoon shift.
  • Coordinate and assign preventative maintenance, scheduled repairs, and emergency response.
  • Train, mentor, and onboard new maintenance personnel.
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues and ensure timely, effective resolutions.
  • Maintain compliance with HAACP, SQF, and GMP standards.
  • Inspect facility and equipment for proper function and safety compliance.
  • Assist with inventory management and upkeep of tools and equipment.
  • Complete and submit accurate documentation and maintenance logs.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours support.

What You’ll Bring:

  • High school diploma (or equivalent) required, associate’s degree from a technical school preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of mechanical experience in a manufacturing setting; 5+ years preferred.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage team dynamics effectively.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems, including pneumatics, hydraulics, PLCs, VFDs, and control safety circuits.
  • Experience with welding, machining, fabrication, HVAC, boilers, and ammonia systems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with OSHA safety standards and arc flash regulations.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting and problem-solving.
  • Comfortable lifting up to 50 lbs. and working independently or within a team.
  • Experience with SAP or similar CMMS software is advantageous.

job.title: Call center
job.description:
Collections Representative

Location: Newark, Delaware | 100% On-Site
Pay: $18.00 per hour
Schedule: Full-Time, Flexible Day/Evening Availability Required
Training: Paid, Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-4:30 PM

Position Overview

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking Collections Representatives for an established financial services and accounts receivable organization in Newark, Delaware.

This is an excellent opportunity for customer service professionals interested in transitioning into the collections industry. Previous collections experience is preferred but not required. Comprehensive training is provided to help you develop the skills needed to succeed.

As a Collections Representative, you will communicate with consumers by phone, provide professional customer service, discuss account and payment matters, and work toward appropriate resolutions. Successful candidates will be comfortable having financial conversations while remaining professional, respectful, and attentive to established procedures.

What You'll Do

  • Communicate professionally with consumers regarding their accounts.
  • Provide a positive customer experience while handling potentially sensitive financial conversations.
  • Work with consumers to understand their circumstances and identify appropriate account resolutions.
  • Accurately document conversations, account information, and outcomes.
  • Follow established policies, procedures, scripts, and compliance requirements.
  • Handle inbound and outbound telephone communication professionally.
  • Meet established performance, quality, attendance, and productivity expectations.
  • Participate fully in training and ongoing coaching.
  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling consumer information.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Previous customer service experience.
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Professional and respectful telephone presence.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused during challenging conversations.
  • Comfortable discussing account and payment-related matters.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to learn new systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work 100% on-site in Newark, DE.
  • Ability to meet all scheduling requirements.

Preferred:

  • Previous collections or accounts receivable experience.
  • Previous call center or high-volume customer contact experience.

Collections experience is a plus, but it is not required. Candidates with a strong customer service background who are interested in making a career change are encouraged to apply.

Schedule Requirements

Candidates must be available for all required scheduling needs, including:

  • Day shift: 8:00 AM-5:00 PM
  • Evening shift: 12:00 PM-9:00 PM, at least two evenings per week
  • Saturdays: Up to every other Saturday, 8:00 AM-12:00 PM

This is an in-office position with no remote option.

Mandatory Training

Training is mandatory:

Monday-Friday | 8:30 AM-4:30 PM

Each training day includes a one-hour lunch and two paid 15-minute breaks. Candidates must be able to attend the complete training schedule.

Workplace Expectations

  • Dress Code: Business Casual
  • Maintain a professional approach when interacting with consumers and team members.
  • Be dependable and prepared to work assigned schedules.
  • Successfully complete required training and ongoing development.

Interview Process

Qualified candidates will participate in a structured interview process. Candidates selected to interview should be prepared to:

  • Review the complete job description and scheduling requirements before interviewing.
  • Confirm reliable transportation to the Newark office for all scheduled shifts.
  • Discuss their customer service experience and interest in collections.
  • Identify Integrity Staffing Solutions as the staffing agency that referred them.

Candidates with direct collections experience may receive priority interview consideration.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

If you have customer service experience and are looking for an opportunity to develop a new skill set, this position provides a pathway into the collections and financial services industry. You'll receive the training necessary to learn the role while building valuable experience in customer communication, account resolution, and financial services.

Ready to take the next step? Apply today with Integrity Staffing Solutions to be considered for an upcoming Collections Representative training class.
