job.title: Amazon Sortation Center Warehouse Associate
job.description:
Amazon Sortation Center Warehouse Associate

Location:
Plainfield, IN
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $22.75

Job Overview
You’ll be part of the dedicated Amazon team that is the first stop on the journey from the warehouse. Our fast-paced, physical roles take place in a sortation center. You will be sorting, scanning, and stacking packages on pallets, helping to get customer orders ready for delivery. Because most of the shifts are part-time, you are in control of your schedule choosing shifts that work best for you now and the ability to adjust your schedule in the future, as needed.


Duties & Responsibilities

Some of your duties may include:

  1. Receive and sort inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready for delivery
  3. Use technology like scanners, computers, and handheld printers

You'll also need to be able to:

  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  3. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  4. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  5. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)


What it’s like at an Amazon Sortation Center

  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.


Why You'll Love this Job

  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Anytime Pay. You can instantly cash out up to 70% of your earnings immediately after your shift (for select employee groups). Learn more about Anytime Pay..
  5. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  6. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn how to use the latest Amazon technology – including handheld devices and robotics.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.


Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:

  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program

Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture

https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/

https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/


Requirements:

  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirement and safety guidelines


How To Get Started
You can begin by applying above. If you need help with your application or to learn more about our hiring process, you can find support here: https://hiring.amazon.com/hiring-process#/.

job.title: Commercial Building Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Job Summary:
In this role you’ll be face-to-face ambassador of the company dealing directly with our clients.

You’ll assist the property supervisor in maintaining the physical aspects of the Indiana buildings by performing light repair and maintenance duties for both common areas of buildings and within tenant spaces; inspecting, investigating, or assessing conditions to be performed by third party vendors; inspecting, investing or assessing conditions after all work has been completed by such vendors.

This role requires a hands-on, highly skilled technician who can independently diagnose, repair, and maintain building systems while serving as the Owner Representative holding vendors accountable to Meritex standards, alongside the Senior Property Manager.
The ideal candidate has deep experience in commercial or industrial facilities, strong troubleshooting skills across multiple trades, and the professionalism to interact with tenants, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Support basic requests by tenants for repair, maintenance and projects, utilize vendors
  • Perform maintenance tasks as directed by supervisor.
  • Maintain good tenant relations – complete or escalate support for repairs as needed
  • Partner with vendors and contractors to check in to see if projects are on track.
  • Regularly inspect HVAC, fire/life safety equipment, document results and notify supervisor and vendor of any issues.
  • Keep supervisor informed as to status of work orders and work assignments.
  • Ensure all properties are free of trash and debris.
  • Replace lights and ceiling tiles and paint when needed.
  • Communicate all building and tenant issues to supervisor.
  • Be knowledgeable and continuously promote safe work practices. Complete all required training including OSHA trainings.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education/Skills/Experience/Qualities:

  • 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in an industrial commercial setting
  • Knowledge of fire systems, managing vendors, bidding projects, HVAC
  • High school diploma or equivalent (requires some technical college or applicable certifications).
  • Dependability and a valid Indiana driver’s license, good driving record, ability to travel to multiple properties and comply with company policies with vehicle usage are required.
  • Ability to multitask, remain flexible and professional.
  • Maintain a positive team attitude and provide excellent customer service.
  • Mechanical aptitude, ability to read schematics/engineering
  • Requires walking and driving to properties, bending, twisting, lifting up to 20 lbs., and climbing fixed ladders to access roofs and extension ladders
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.

job.description:
¡Estamos buscando Operadores de Equipo de Almacén para trabajar en la instalación climatizada de nuestro cliente! Gana hasta $21.00 por hora en un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, activo y agradable, colaborando con una empresa líder en comercio electrónico.

Se requiere un mínimo de 6 meses de experiencia operando equipo industrial motorizado, también conocido como PIT por sus siglas en inglés.

EVENTO DE CONTRATACION DE PUERTAS ABIERTAS
Fecha: Martes 3 de noviembre o jueves 5 de noviembre
Hora: 9:00am-3:00pm
Direccion del evento: 2900 S Valley Pkwy, Suite 100, Lewisville, TX 75067

Beneficios y ventajas

  • Pago semanal
  • Beneficios desde el primer día, incluyendo seguro médico, dental y telemedicina
  • Programa de asistencia para empleados
  • Programa 401(k)
  • Acceso anticipado a salarios aún no pagados a través de PayActiv


Tarifa de pago: $20.00 por hora

Horarios de turno, según disponibilidad:

  • Varios turnos disponibles
  • La orientación será a las 9:00 a. m. el primer día


Responsabilidades principales

  • Recibir y almacenar inventario
  • Empacar y enviar pedidos de acuerdo con las especificaciones del cliente
  • Cargar cajas en camiones para su envío
  • Mantener registros de inventario precisos
  • Escanear y etiquetar artículos de inventario
  • Organizar y almacenar inventario de manera segura y eficiente
  • Identificar y resolver problemas operativos
  • Operar y dar mantenimiento básico al equipo de almacén
  • Mantener el almacén limpio y organizado
  • Seguir todos los procedimientos de seguridad
  • Reportar inmediatamente cualquier peligro o inquietud relacionada con la seguridad
  • Comunicarse de manera efectiva con otros miembros del equipo de almacén


Requisitos principales

  • Mínimo de 1 año de experiencia en un almacén o en un entorno similar
  • Capacidad para levantar hasta 50 libras
  • Capacidad para empujar carros utilitarios de hasta 60 libras
  • Capacidad para subir y bajar escaleras, cuando aplique
  • Capacidad para trabajar a una altura de hasta 40 pies en un entrepiso o mezanine, cuando aplique
  • Fuertes habilidades de organización y manejo del tiempo
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y como parte de un equipo
  • Capacidad para seguir instrucciones y trabajar de manera segura
  • Diploma de escuela secundaria o GED
  • Debe poder leer, escribir y comunicarse en inglés
  • Debe contar con sólidas habilidades interpersonales y de comunicación
  • Debe ser confiable, tener buenas habilidades de manejo del tiempo y poder trabajar a un ritmo constante
  • Capacidad para caminar, estar de pie, agacharse y doblarse durante 8 a 10 horas durante el turno para localizar artículos de pedidos, organizar productos y completar pedidos
  • Levantamiento repetitivo y regular de 20 a 35 libras
  • Movimiento de cajas de hasta 40 libras para acceder al producto
  • Uso ocasional de un banco pequeño o escalera para alcanzar productos ubicados en estantes superiores

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
NEW INCREASED PAY RATES STARTING AT $19.00 PER HOUR!!!

Now hiring Material Handlers in Reno, Nevada for full-time first and second shift opportunities starting at $19.00/hour, with up to $21.50/hour available depending on shift. This is a temp-to-hire opportunity in a clean, climate-controlled manufacturing environment with overtime potential, occasional free lunches, and a chance to build hands-on warehouse and production experience with IGT.

Benefits

  • Medical and dental benefits
  • Weekly pay
  • Free online career advancement training
  • Temp-to-hire opportunity
  • Overtime opportunities that includes voluntary and mandatory OT.
  • Associate-first support from Integrity Staffing


About the Role
As a warehouse associate, you’ll help move raw materials, parts, and equipment throughout the facility while supporting warehouse, production, receiving, shipping, and inventory functions. This role is ideal for someone who can work safely, stay active throughout the shift, and follow detailed instructions in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.

Pay Rate:

  • $19.00 /hour starting pay for first shift.
  • $21.00/hour starting pay for second shift.


Available Shift Times

  • 1st Shift: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM
  • 2nd Shift: Monday–Friday, 2:30 PM – 11:00 PM


Key Responsibilities

  • Move materials and parts using handheld tools, machinery, and equipment
  • Support receiving, shipping, production support, and inventory restocking
  • Pick parts accurately in a deadline-driven environment
  • Maintain stock in work areas and help ensure inventory accuracy
  • Use computers and basic systems to document workflows and job activity
  • Follow manufacturing and safety procedures at all times
  • Assist in multiple warehouse or production areas as needed


Key Requirements

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent required
  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs. or more regularly
  • Ability to stand for a full shift
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Comfortable using computers, hand tools, and power tools
  • Able to interpret and follow manufacturing instructions
  • Must be able to pass a security background investigation
  • Must wear steel toe boots
  • Weekend and overtime availability may be REQUIRED

job.title: Utility Assembly Associate
job.description:
Now hiring an Electrical Assembler Associate in Suwanee, GA! This position offers shift flexibility, with hours from 6:00 am to 2:45 pm Monday through Friday, including overtime opportunities, and pays $18.00-$20.00+ per hour. This temp-to-perm role is perfect for individuals with a high school diploma or equivalent who are interested in electrical assembly and manufacturing support.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay
  • Opportunity for permanent placement
  • Overtime potential
  • Community resources and educational programs

About the Role
As an Electrical Assembler Associate, you will interpret electrical wiring diagrams, assemble wiring for equipment, and support manufacturing teams with assembly tasks. You will be responsible for reading and understanding drawings, measuring and cutting wiring, and working effectively within a team to support production schedules and safety standards. Cross-training across departments is encouraged to meet production demands.

Pay Rate: $18.00/hr

Available Shift Times

  • 6:00 am – 2:45 pm, Monday-Friday plus OT

Key Responsibilities

  • Layout and assemble wiring for equipment
  • Read and interpret electrical drawings and legends
  • Measure, cut, and wire components according to specifications
  • Operate hand tools safely and effectively
  • Support lean manufacturing initiatives and maintain a clean, organized work environment

Key Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Ability to interpret electrical wiring diagrams and mechanical knowledge recommended
  • Understanding of electrical components such as contactors, breakers, transformers, communication boards
  • Basic math skills and ability to read a tape measure
  • Willingness to cross-train and work in multiple departments
  • Ability to follow safety procedures and work collaboratively with team members

job.title: Electrical Assembler B
job.description:
Now hiring an Electrical Assembler B in Suwanee, GA! This temp-to-perm role offers a competitive pay rate of $18.00-$20.00+ per hour, with shift variety including Monday through Friday, from 6:00 AM to 3:45 PM, and some mandatory Saturdays. Enjoy the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment focused on electrical wiring and component assembly for refrigeration equipment, with potential for permanent placement.

Benefits

  • Medical and Dental coverage
  • Online education programs
  • Financial tools and community resources
  • Opportunities for career growth

About the Role
As an Electrical Assembler B, you will assemble and install electrical wiring and components for refrigeration systems. Your responsibilities include reading wiring diagrams, measuring, routing, terminating wiring, installing electrical components, and performing quality inspections to ensure safety and standards compliance.

Pay Rate: $18.00/hour
Available Shift Times: Monday – Friday, 6:00 AM – 3:45 PM (Some mandatory Saturdays)

Key Responsibilities

  • Layout and assemble electrical wiring for refrigeration systems
  • Read wiring diagrams, schematics, and assembly drawings
  • Measure, cut, route, and terminate wiring
  • Install electrical components including breakers, contactors, transformers, and control boards
  • Utilize hand tools and electrical assembly equipment
  • Verify wire gauges, color codes, and component placement
  • Perform quality inspections and correct assembly issues
  • Support lean manufacturing initiatives and continuous improvement efforts
  • Cross-train in other production departments as needed

Key Requirements

  • Experience with electrical assembly and wiring diagrams
  • Knowledge of electrical components and wire routing & termination
  • Ability to use hand tools and electrical assembly equipment
  • Focus on quality inspection and safety compliance

job.title: FC Warehouse Associate - $1000 Sign-on Bonus
job.description:
Amazon Fulfillment Center Warehouse Associate

Shifts:
Day, Overnight, Weekend

Location:
Chester, VA
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $21.50, plus up to $1,000* sign-on bonus, when you start your Day 1 prior to 12/5/2026
*Bonus terms:
Bonuses offered for a limited time only
Bonuses are only applicable to specific job types and shifts; additional terms and conditions may apply
Associates must be employed at the time of the payout
Payouts will occur in installments

Job Overview
You’ll be part of the Amazon warehouse team that gets orders ready for customers relying on Amazon services. Our fast-paced, physical roles take place in a variety of areas including merch, make-on-demand, customer returns, Prime Now, and general fulfillment. You will be selecting, packing, and shipping orders – in some cases, for our super-fast (2-hour or less) delivery service.


Duties & Responsibilities

Some of your duties may include:

  1. Receive and put away inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready and pack them up
  3. Load boxes into trucks for shipment
  4. Use scanners to read bar codes on products
  5. View prompts on screens and follow the direction for some tasks
  6. Troubleshoot problems
  7. Ensure product meets quality requirements
  8. Operate power industrial trucks (PIT) such as a forklift or pallet driver, and work at heights up to 35 feet. Equipment training and certification are provided free of cost.

You'll also need to be able to:

  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Push utility carts up to 60 pounds
  3. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  4. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  5. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  6. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  7. Adhere to strict safety, quality, and fulfillment production standards


What it's like at an Amazon Fulfillment Center

  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.


Why You’ll Love this Job

  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  5. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn: how to operate a garment press and high-capacity printer, a t-shirt folding machine, how to assist with the print production process, or how to receive and process customer returns.
  6. Free training. Depending on the role and location, we’ll teach you how to drive power industrial trucks (PIT) such as forklifts or a pallet driver, how the printing process works, and how to work with the latest Amazon technology – including robots.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.


Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:

  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program

Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture

https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/

https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/


Requirements:

  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.


How To Get Started
You can begin by applying above. If you need help with your application or to learn more about our hiring process, you can find support here: https://hiring.amazon.com/hiring-process#/.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

job.title: Asociado de Almacén
job.description:
Puesto: Asociado de Almacén — 1.er y 2.º Turnos
Pay: $17.50 to $19.00
Ubicación: Phillipsburg, NJ
Duración: Asignación a largo plazo
¡¡Nosotros hablamos español!!

Buscamos un Asociado de Almacén motivado y confiable para unirse a nuestro equipo. Como Asociado de Almacén, desempeñará un papel fundamental para garantizar el funcionamiento eficiente y seguro de nuestro almacén. Sus responsabilidades incluirán la carga y descarga de camiones, así como el empaque, la preparación (picking) y el envío de pedidos. Deberá asegurarse de que el producto no presente daños y verificar que la cantidad, la calidad, el etiquetado y el direccionamiento de los pedidos correspondan a las especificaciones del cliente o a otros requisitos. Trabajará en estrecha colaboración con otros miembros del equipo del almacén para garantizar que todas las tareas se completen con precisión y a tiempo.

Turno: Los turnos varían los 7 días de la semana

Horario de los turnos: varios horarios
Hay disponibilidad de horas extras

Tarifa salarial: $17.50- $19.00 por hora

Beneficios y ventajas:

  • Pago semanal
  • Beneficios desde el primer día: ¡médicos, dentales y de la vista, incluida la telemedicina!
  • Visitas ilimitadas de telemedicina y atención de urgencia para usted y su familia
  • Seguro de vida temporal colectivo para el empleado, su cónyuge e hijos
  • Cobertura por discapacidad a corto plazo
  • Programa de tarjeta de descuentos en medicamentos recetados para quienes estén inscritos en los beneficios médicos
  • Acceso a nuestro Programa de Asistencia al Empleado
  • Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo de habilidades
  • Posibilidad de unirse a nuestro programa 401(k)


Deberes y responsabilidades esenciales:

  • Cargar y descargar envíos
  • Verificar, documentar e informar sobre cualquier daño o discrepancia en comparación con el manifiesto de carga
  • Confirmar todos los documentos de la carga
  • Generar un informe de daños ante cualquier desperfecto
  • Recibir, contar y clasificar envíos
  • Preparar y paletizar envíos
  • Medir y pesar envíos
  • Envolver palés manualmente con película retráctil (shrink wrap)
  • Seleccionar, extraer y empacar pedidos de distribución con precisión
  • Asegurarse de que se observen y cumplan todas las normas de carga, seguridad y protección
  • Colaborar en la limpieza y el mantenimiento general del almacén
  • Informar de inmediato a la gerencia sobre fallas en el servicio o problemas que deban abordarse directamente con el cliente
  • Otras tareas asignadas por el supervisor (Lead) o gerente, según las necesidades del departamento, su desempeño y sus capacidades
  • Disposición para trabajar en un horario de turnos rotativos de 8 a 10 horas, si fuera necesario


Requisitos:

  • Mínimo de 1 año de experiencia en un almacén o entorno similar
  • Capacidad para levantar hasta 49 libras (aprox. 22 kg)
  • Uso de carros, carretillas de mano y otros equipos para mover artículos
  • Subir y bajar escaleras (donde corresponda)
  • Sólidas habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo
  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y como parte de un equipo
  • Capacidad para seguir instrucciones y trabajar de manera segura

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
About Integrity: At Integrity, we specialize in providing tailored staffing solutions to middle-market companies, ensuring their workforce needs are met with excellence.

We are looking for a dynamic Strategic Hunter to drive sales and profitability for mid-size light industrial accounts your assgined territory.

As a key member of our sales team, you will focus on hunting and closing new business, executing strategic sales methods, and establishing long-term customer relationships.

You'll need to be located in daily commutable distance to Reno, NV and familiar with the local market(s) for consideration.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospecting & Cold Calling: Independently prospect and cold call regional accounts that match Integrity’s client profile—businesses with at 10+ full-time employees, year-round, and a high ROI potential.
  • Strategic Sales Execution: Apply sales techniques to tailor your communication and sales approach to different personality types, build rapport and trust with potential clients.
  • Develop and Close New Accounts: Drive sales through proactive calls, strategic presentations, and customized proposals for staffing solutions. Transition prospects into long-term clients by addressing their needs and offering tailored solutions.
  • Sales Cycle Management: Manage the entire sales process from initial prospecting through to successful close and hand off implementation to Operations.
  • Relationship Building: Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within assigned accounts. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring that their staffing requirements and expectations are met and exceeded.
  • Account Planning: Lead the customer account planning cycle to ensure successful engagement, addressing both short-term and long-term business goals.
  • Market and Competitor Analysis: Continuously assess market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to identify new opportunities and stay ahead of industry changes.
  • Sales Negotiation & Closing: Negotiate pricing and terms effectively, ensuring profitable sales and securing long-term contracts with regional clients.
  • CRM Management: Keep an up-to-date record of all sales activities, follow-up tasks, and client interactions in Bullhorn system for accurate forecasting and reporting.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure customer requirements are fulfilled and that all service levels are met.

How We Measure Results

  • Achieve Sales Quotas: Meet or exceed assigned sales quotas and profitability targets for new business.
  • Strategic Objectives: Deliver on strategic customer objectives defined by company leadership.
  • Account Growth: Successfully grow new accounts by consistently hitting quarterly and yearly sales goals, including profitability, account acquisition, and client retention.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, with a proven track record in building a new book of business and meeting/exceeding goals. Staffing industry experience is highly preferred.
  • Strong cold calling and lead generation abilities, with an independent approach to prospecting and developing new regional accounts.
  • A strong understanding of all decision maker personality types to guide your sales strategy, allowing you to adapt your communication and close effectively with a diverse range of customers.
  • Consultative Selling: Exceptional consultative sales skills with the ability to analyze client needs and present tailored solutions that drive value.
  • Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively within a results-driven, team-oriented environment while maintaining individual accountability.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field is highly preferred.

  • Flex hours vary depending on the week and time of year.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to travel to support other locations as needed;
MAIN LOCATION : 165 Business Blvd., Clear Brook, Virginia 22624

Requirements:

  • Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle challenging situations, and multitask in a high-volume, ever-changing environment.

  • Assist candidates to guarantee an accurate and seamless onboarding process, verifying the completion of all application and pre-hire tasks promptly and accurately through the Applicant Tracking System and other technologies.

job.title: Quality Assurance Technician - 3rd Shift
job.description:
Now hiring Quality Assurance Technician — 3rd Shift, M-F 11p-7:15a in Sparks, Nevada! Join our dynamic team in a climate-controlled environment where your attention to detail and quality assurance skills are vital. This temp-to-hire role offers a competitive pay rate of $19.00 per hour, with weekly pay, comprehensive benefits starting Day 1, and on-the-job training opportunities. Be part of a leading plastic injection molding operation where safety, quality, and teamwork drive success.

Benefits

  • Weekly pay
  • Day 1 benefits including medical, dental, and telemedicine
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) program
  • Potential on-the-job forklift training
  • Paid overtime and shift differentials
  • Temp-to-hire after 520 hours


About the Role
As a QA Technician on the night shift, your role is crucial in ensuring the highest product quality through detailed inspections, precise documentation, and adherence to safety protocols. You will perform critical tasks including press walk-through inspections, sampling and testing, cavity defect reporting, and verifying operational parameters. Your keen eye for detail helps maintain compliance with SQF standards and guarantees that only premium products reach our clients. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals eager to develop their quality assurance expertise within a supportive environment.

Pay Rate: $19.00 per hour

Shift Times: Monday through Friday, 11:00 PM – 7:15 AM

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform shift change inspections of presses, conveyors, secondary production, and warehouse areas, exchanging critical information with the outgoing inspector and verifying equipment functions.
  • Review shift reports and critical information at start-up from outgoing shifts.
  • Pull, inspect, and cool parts from each press twice per shift, checking for molding defects like shorts, flash, pin-holes, pulled threads, and contamination; verify cavity count.
  • Gather and fill out worksheets such as QA product check, finish goods audit, secondary checklist, and sizing reports, ensuring accurate documentation using work orders and LDR sheets.
  • Check pump settings, material, and colorant against LDR sheets; update sheets with current lot numbers as needed.
  • Verify work order BOM matches materials used; confirm proper documentation and initialed paperwork for each operator.
  • Allow caps to cool at least one hour before sizing, and measure sizes using gages; document and notify the foreman of issues.
  • Conduct U5 foam tear tests, log results, and report any concerns immediately.
  • Assist with cavity turning-off processes, collecting samples, completing defect reports, and bagging caps for cavity defects.
  • Pull, bag, and tag first and last shots per color and material change, including collecting ash testing samples and defective cavity paperwork.
  • Check start-up checklists, validate LDR sheet accuracy, and ensure proper initializations; report any discrepancies.
  • Perform half-hourly QA inspections across presses, production, and pallet staging, noting defects and adjustments in Q.A. product check sheets.
  • Test Kleen-Peel labels using tension gauges during each walk-through, and verify SOP adherence for inspector sampling every two hours.
  • Ensure scales, counters, and auto-bag sealing are properly calibrated and functioning; verify correct box loading, labeling, and taping.
  • Assist with Super Quad operations during breaks, and support pallet rotation, press alarms, and job start-up/shutdown as needed.
  • Maintain inner caps molding and storage areas, change gaylords, and ensure shot counts are accurate and area is sanitized.
  • Review and verify non-conforming products, utilizing the non-conformance process and completing corrective action reports as necessary.
  • Conduct warehouse audits on finished goods from the previous shift, logging results into the designated folder.
  • Enter all required documentation into the QA lot traceability database and submit samples and reports to QA management.
  • Setup and monitor vision systems during production, ensuring proper operation and troubleshooting when necessary.
  • Record leakage amounts at leak test stations, top off water and cleaning supplies, and perform other duties as assigned.
  • Maintain organization and cleanliness of the QA area, and provide shift reports via email at end of the shift.


Key Requirements

  • Ability to stand for long periods and perform detailed inspections
  • Lift/move up to 20 pounds with proper techniques
  • Comfortable working in a climate-controlled environment
  • Strong vision, including close vision, color acuity, and peripheral vision
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and safety protocols
  • Exposure to mechanical parts and loud environments expected
  • Steel toe safety shoes required
  • Own transportation recommended (not on bus route)
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and team mindset
  • Additional Details
  • Client rehire eligibility: Yes, based on performance and policy adherence
  • Training: First two weeks on first shift, with ongoing support
  • Pre-hire activities include resume review, site tour, and interview
  • Next steps: Submit your application, complete interviews and pre-employment steps, and get ready for a rewarding role in quality assurance

job.title: Robotics Warehouse Associate - $3000 Sign-on Bonus
job.description:
Amazon Robotics Warehouse Associate

Shifts:
Day, Night, Weekend

Location:
Etna, OH
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $23.00, plus up to $3,000* sign-on bonus, when you start your Day 1 prior to 12/5/2026
*Bonus terms:
• Bonuses offered for a limited time only
• Bonuses are only applicable to specific job types and shifts; additional terms and conditions may apply
• Associates must be employed at the time of the payout
• Payouts will occur in installments

Job Overview
Join one of the most innovative warehouse roles at Amazon. You'll gain hands-on experience working alongside robotics technology, stowing and picking items using automated systems, packing orders for customers, and getting a firsthand look at how Amazon is reshaping the future of warehouse work — all while helping ensure customers receive their orders on time.

Duties & Responsibilities

Some of your duties may include:

  1. Receive and put away inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready and pack them up
  3. Load boxes into trucks for shipment
  4. Use scanners to read bar codes on products
  5. View prompts on screens and follow the direction for some tasks
  6. Troubleshoot problems
  7. Ensure product meets quality requirements
  8. Operate power industrial trucks (PIT) such as a forklift or pallet driver, and work at heights up to 35 feet. Equipment training and certification are provided free of cost.

You'll also need to be able to:

  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Push utility carts up to 60 pounds
  3. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  4. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  5. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  6. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  7. Adhere to strict safety, quality, and fulfillment production standards

What it's like at an Amazon Fulfillment Center

  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.

Why You’ll Love this Job

  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  5. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn: how to operate a garment press and high-capacity printer, a t-shirt folding machine, how to assist with the print production process, or how to receive and process customer returns.
  6. Free training. Depending on the role and location, we’ll teach you how to drive power industrial trucks (PIT) such as forklifts or a pallet driver, how the printing process works, and how to work with the latest Amazon technology – including robots.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.

Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:

  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program

Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture

https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/

https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/

Requirements:

  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

How To Get Started
You can begin by applying above. If you need help with your application or to learn more about our hiring process, you can find support here: https://hiring.amazon.com/hiring-process#/.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

Job Overview

You’ll be part of the dedicated Amazon team at the delivery station – the last stop before we deliver smiles to customers. Our fast-paced, physical roles receive trucks full of orders, then prepare them for delivery. You’ll load conveyor belts, and transport and stage deliveries to be picked up by drivers. You may even be part of the team that works with larger items, such as large screen TVs, furniture, and appliances, and be trained on how to use technology to handle these heavy bulk items.

Duties & Responsibilities

Some of your duties may include:

  1. Receive and prepare inventory for delivery
  2. Use technology like smartphones and handheld devices to sort, scan, and prepare orders
  3. View prompts on screens and follow direction for some tasks
  4. Build, wrap, sort, and transport pallets and packages
  5. Receive truck deliveries

You’ll also need to be able to:

  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  3. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  4. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  5. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)

  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.

  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.
